newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 3c to 575c/kg.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool indicator rises 3c to 575c/kg.

text.p: The Australian wool market eastern indicator rose three cents to 575 cents a kg clean on Wednesday in Sydney and Melbourne, Wool International (WI) said.
Merino fleece prices were mostly dearer, with the 19/20 micron indicators 1.5 percent dearer and 21m slightly dearer.
The 22/23/24/25m categories were 0.5 percent dearer but 26m was slightly cheaper.
In crossbreds, 27m was slightly dearer and 28/29m slightly cheaper. The 30m category was unchanged, while 31m was 0.5 percent cheaper.
In cardings, lambs were unchanged, locks generally unchanged and crutchings firm, WI said.
WI said Japanese and Chinese interests were the principal buyers with support from Taiwan and Western Europe.
Of the 19,086 bales offered, 7.3 percent were passed in.
Sales continue Thursday in Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle with about 34,300 bales to be offered.
